# Tasks

These are proposed slices, not completed implementation. Estimates include each slice's checks and documentation; stop and replan when a timebox expires.

## 1. Prove launch enforcement first (20 minutes)

- [ ] 1.1 In 10 minutes, define the brief/outcome revision contract and add missing-section, stale-outcome, pending-seat and exempt fixtures; verify the launcher refuses bypasses with named errors.
- [ ] 1.2 In 10 minutes, implement the portable brief-check entry point and document the launcher hook; verify complete and exempt controls pass and every negative fixture fails as intended.

## 2. Canonical skill and review mode (25 minutes)

- [ ] 2.1 In 10 minutes, add jig-plan's one-page template and provider scenarios, generate the Claude pointer; verify sync-skills.mjs --check and the readable example contain every required section.
- [ ] 2.2 In 15 minutes, add jig-review plan mode reusing seats, testing/cost/history defaults and signal-based additions; verify selection, 120-word limit, timeout and blocking-gap fixtures and document the two-minute target.

## 3. Connect intake and history (15 minutes)

- [ ] 3.1 In 10 minutes, reference the shared plan from jig-verify, jig-mockup and jig-correct and update the brief template and suite; verify all three reference one contract rather than duplicating seats.
- [ ] 3.2 In 5 minutes, connect relevant missed-problems intake and incident-linked repeat handling; verify an open-repeat fixture blocks and the plan names its check.

## 4. Provider and platform integration (15 minutes initially)

- [ ] 4.1 Within 10 minutes of authorized provider time, run fresh Claude Code and Codex loading/missing/valid/exempt scenarios, record outcomes and tokens; verify planted omissions are caught by both, otherwise leave parity pending.
- [ ] 4.2 In 5 minutes, run portable checker fixtures on Windows and macOS when available and present one plan for readability acceptance; verify unsupported/unrun platform evidence stays explicitly pending.

## Workflow follow-up

- Independent plan check and person/launcher authorization remain required before any actual implementation launch.
- Archive only after implementation and required acceptance; this spike's archive copy is a merge experiment and proves no implementation.
